prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 3D game decoration TEXTURE SOURCE / unlit albedo painting.
Produce ONE 1024 x 1024 PNG with a truly transparent background, retaining this square canvas at its original resolution.
Input 1, guide_left.png, is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry authority. Paint directly over its existing grey object. Input 2, design_reference.png, is the approved colour and material authority only. Input 3, concept_crop.png, is supporting original concept only.

Paint the LEFT orthographic view of The Seedship. The guide's object occupies x=66..957 and y=391..631 of a 1024-square image, a long low horizontal hull in the middle with large transparent margins above and below. The tall curled tail is at the LEFT, pointed armoured bow at the RIGHT. Do not fill the canvas or enlarge it. Preserve exactly the guide's camera, silhouette, object position, size, aspect ratio, every spike, rib, plate, edge, opening, and all alpha coverage. Keep the exact curvature and tip coordinates of both tall terminal horns, the existing row of small upper spines, the side ribs and hanging underside spikes. No new or removed geometry, no changed proportions, no perspective or three-quarter rotation. The material reference must never override guide geometry.

Change only surface colour/material: dark violet-black resin hull; the EXISTING projecting bone ribs and plates painted warm ivory with thin gold-brown veins; luminous saturated amber-orange sacs/openings between ribs, using the reference's organic cellular motif as surface painting; ivory spines. Match the design reference's colour, fine organic vein pattern and material identity without importing its different outline or spike arrangement. All marks stay inside existing guide alpha. Preserve existing transparent gaps.

Lighting: flat, even, shadowless frontal illumination, an albedo texture painting. No directional shading, no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light. Orange sacs and seams have their glowing orange colour only: no bloom, no halo, and no orange light cast onto nearby surfaces. No background, floor, environment, text, border or extra objects. Return the whole unresized 1024-square canvas, not a cropped close-up.
reason: Superseded by the one permitted corrective regeneration. Raw return has the wrong dimensions, silhouette/alpha drift, and stronger shading than requested.

checks.materials_and_colours: Broad palette match: dark violet-black hull, ivory bone, thin gold-brown veins, amber-orange cells.
checks.lighting_reason: Painted shaded recesses and bright bone highlights remain.
